description: This is a test class for the MongoQuery component within the Elasticsearch persistence layer of the org.eclipse.ditto.services.thingsearch.persistence.read.query package. It contains unit tests for verifying the correctness, immutability, and sorting behavior of MongoQuery instances used for database querying.

classes.name: MongoQueryTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for MongoQuery, verifying criteria, sorting, immutability, and equality.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes static test fixture by loading configuration before any tests run.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Sets up common test data before each test execution, including default sort options and expected BSON.

methods.name: hashcodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that MongoQuery correctly implements hashCode and equals methods.

methods.name: immutability
methods.description: Checks that MongoQuery instances are immutable and that their components are also immutable.

methods.name: criteriaIsCorrectlySet
methods.description: Tests that the criteria of MongoQuery are properly assigned.

methods.name: emptySortOptions
methods.description: Verifies behavior when no sort options are provided.

methods.name: sortOptionsAreCorrectlySet
methods.description: Checks correct assignment and BSON conversion of provided sort options.

methods.name: assertBson
methods.description: Utility method to compare expected and actual BSON documents for equality.
